crime: Every morning, {WITCH_NAME}'s roommate read the ice first, the way her grandfather had taught her, then skated figures across the frozen lake for whoever watched from the shore. {WITCH_NAME} watched.

Once, her roommate brushed the snow aside and showed her the difference between white ice and black. "There are always signs," she said. "Even the day you lost your father had them. You'll never need a bell."

{WITCH_NAME} had been seven, shelling peas on the back step on an ordinary day, when her father called "Nearly done" from the roof and slid past her without a sound. That day gave no sign. So she would be the sign, for everyone after.
In the prison she called out every bell the moment she heard it toll, and never once held one back.

One evening she took a stone from the shore, broke a hole in the middle of her roommate's skating lane, and swept snow over it so no sign showed. That night in their cell she lay awake below her roommate's upper bunk, hearing a bell toll from her until morning, and said nothing.

Next morning, as her roommate glided onto the middle of the lake, {WITCH_NAME} cried out from the shore: "A bell! A bell from you! Come back!" Mid-glide, her roommate dropped through the ice and did not come up.
In the trial court, the prisoners agreed the ice had simply given way, just as the bell had warned. {WITCH_NAME} had cried out from the shore right beside them.

Then a prisoner lifted a broken piece from the hole: black new ice, a finger thick, inside a ring of old white ice. The prisoners understood. The hole had frozen over through the night, so the bell had been tolling from the bunk above {WITCH_NAME} since lockup, and the girl who called out every bell at once had held this one back until they were all watching.
fields.epitaph: She gave her friend the day with no sign: the one she swore no one would ever have again.
fields.epithet: The Girl Who Would Be the Sign
execution: A great bell hung in a frame above her, its rope knotted round her neck. The bell swung and tolled, and every toll hauled her off her feet by the neck. At last it came to rest mouth up and silent, and she hung still on its rope.

magic.name: The Bell Before
magic.text: She hears a bell toll from anyone harm is coming for, before it reaches them.
